# ChainWard

> On-chain forensics for AI agents on Base. ChainWard reads the chain and files a public risk report for any Base address: a neutral signal band (low-signal, mixed, elevated, high-signal) and every flag it can prove on-chain, each tied to the transactions behind it. Reports describe on-chain behavior only. Absence of flags is not a clearance, and nothing here is a safety verdict.

## Check a counterparty

- Free web check: https://chainward.ai (paste any Base address; the report lives at https://chainward.ai/report/<address>)
- Latest on-chain attestation for an address (free, JSON, includes the canonical report JSON to verify the hash): GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/attestation/<address>
- Fresh report on demand, paid per call over x402 (0.05 USDC on Base, no account; not charged if the check fails): GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/x402?address=<address>
- Where a seller's buyers get their stablecoins (seller-funded buyers, money sent back, common funders), on Base or BNB Chain, paid per call over x402 (0.10 USDC): GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/seller-demand?address=<payTo> (add &chain=bsc for BNB Chain)
- Who hired a BNB Chain ERC-8004 agent, and whether each hirer is the owner, funded by it or shares a funder with it (BNB Chain's Set and Earn rule), paid per call over x402 (0.10 USDC): GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/hires?agent=<id>&chain=bsc
- Set and Earn board, free and daily: every ERC-8004 agent on BNB Chain hired since Oct 1 2026, whenever it was registered, with the hire check's verdict: https://chainward.ai/set-and-earn (JSON: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/set-and-earn/board)
- x402 discovery document: https://api.chainward.ai/.well-known/x402

## ChainWard Attest (EAS on Base)

- Every report that flags observed behavior is attested on Base with the Ethereum Attestation Service. Recipient = the checked address.
- Schema UID: 0x09573690adba41164227b57600aa02061b0ce79dc0655e4c8b36bfe95bb41552
- Attester (only trust this one): 0x5edc6276B89CC185aC8D6A7eCfdE076e1ACf50DF
- Overview: https://chainward.ai/attest
- Docs, schema fields, verification: https://github.com/saltxd/chainward/blob/main/docs/ATTEST.md
- x402 buyer guard (refuses to pay a flagged seller before signing): https://github.com/saltxd/chainward/tree/main/examples/x402-guard

## Investigations

- Published on-chain investigations ("decodes") of Base agents and tokens: https://chainward.ai/decodes
- Custom investigation of any agent or wallet (paid brief): https://chainward.ai/request-brief

## Source

- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/saltxd/chainward
